description: Goal-LR calibration as the first 10k steps of 50k-step wave-1 runs (constant LR, per-step seeded sampler: a 10k run is an exact prefix of a 50k run), then the wave-1 fusion-family slots of this machine. Machine 2 and the lab are not available on 2026-10-03.

tier_a.note: Held-out = the test set kmy17518/isg-init-eval (split eval50: 50 episodes per testbed task, board game included, instances no training demo uses; settle windows cut with --settle-steps 0 like training). The earlier results on isg-init's own 39 held-out episodes stay in <run>/tierA/ and W&B <run>-ta.

runs.name: w1-early-zero-lrg1e-4-s0
runs.role: goal-LR calibration (early, 1e-4): stopped at 10k on 2026-10-03, resumed from its 10k checkpoint to 50k at 22:15 PDT to settle the early goal LR (the 10k rule re-run on the test set no longer picks 1e-3)

runs.role: goal-LR calibration (late, 1e-5): stopped at 10k (late goal LR = 1e-4)

decision_10k.evidence: Tier A at 10k (held-out task means): late 1e-5 vs 1e-4 gap 0.0687 vs 0.0688 (tie), swap 0.014 vs 0.091; early 1e-4 vs 1e-3 gap 0.013 vs 0.035, L1_own 0.0665 vs 0.0697 (+4.8%, inside the 5% guard)
